mapper.select: SELECT a.assignee_ AS "assignee", AVG(a.duration_) as avgTime, COUNT(a.task_def_key_) as "countNum"
mapper.sql:
FROM act_hi_taskinst a
a.duration_ is not null and a.assignee_ is not null
AND a.start_time_ >= str_to_date(#{beginDate},'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
AND a.start_time_ <= str_to_date(#{endDate},'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
AND a.start_time_ >= to_date(#{beginDate},'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
AND a.start_time_ <= to_date(#{endDate},'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
GROUP BY a.assignee_
ORDER BY ${orderBy}
mapper.select: SELECT d.org_name as "assignee", AVG(a.duration_) as avgTime, COUNT(a.task_def_key_) as "countNum"
mapper.sql:
FROM act_hi_taskinst a left join sys_user b on a.assignee_=b.login_name inner join sys_user_org_rel c on b.user_num = c.user_num inner join sys_organization d on c.org_code=d.org_code
a.duration_ is not null and a.assignee_ is not null
AND a.start_time_ >= str_to_date(#{beginDate},'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
AND a.start_time_ <= str_to_date(#{endDate},'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
AND a.start_time_ >= to_date(#{beginDate},'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
AND a.start_time_ <= to_date(#{endDate},'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
GROUP BY d.org_name
ORDER BY ${orderBy}
mapper.select: SELECT b.name_ as "assignee", AVG(a.duration_) as avgTime, COUNT(a.task_def_key_) as "countNum"
mapper.sql:
FROM act_hi_taskinst a left join act_re_procdef b on a.proc_def_id_=b.id_
a.duration_ is not null and a.assignee_ is not null
AND a.start_time_ >= str_to_date(#{beginDate},'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
AND a.start_time_ <= str_to_date(#{endDate},'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
AND a.start_time_ >= to_date(#{beginDate},'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
AND a.start_time_ <= to_date(#{endDate},'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
GROUP BY b.name_
ORDER BY ${orderBy}
